def-hyp(
    list-partial(
        Type.judge(@x, X@Topology.ctxt.X),
        Type.judge(@x_0, X@Topology.ctxt.X),
        Type.judge(@f, Type.to(X@Topology.ctxt.X, Y@Topology.ctxt.Y)),
        Type.judge(@τ_X, Set(Set(X@Topology.ctxt.X))),
        Type.judge(@τ_Y, Set(Set(Y@Topology.ctxt.Y)))
    ),
    Topology.continuous(f, x_0),
    Topology.mapLimit(x, x_0, f, Type.apply(f, x_0))
)
